speakers.biographyMd:
ICT professional with over 20 years experience in software design and development and project management. His insane passion for videogames brought him to be well known through the italian and international game developer communities.
He is also leader of Roma Game Dev community, organizing dedicated meetups and the famous Global Game Jam. He is CTO and Game Developer Content manager of Codemotion
